title: Compaction: cold cache with nothing to prune must not announce a compaction

checks.name: nothing was summarized or pruned (no tool results, below the trigger)
so no compaction was announced either (every compaction.started has a completed marker)

notes: Tool setting: HATCH_PROVIDER_CACHE_TTL_MS=2000 (default 5 minutes) so the cache goes cold within seconds. The conversation is about 190k estimated tokens (prune threshold 131k, summarize trigger 219.5k) and has no tool calls.

defects.title: A cold cache with nothing to prune announces a compaction that never happens
defects.expected: compaction.started only for a compaction that runs to a result; a conversation of 131k-219k tokens with no tool results has nothing to prune and below the trigger nothing to summarize.
defects.actual: 1 compaction.started and 0 compaction.completed, with no history checkpoint. ChatCompaction.inBackground re-schedules itself after the cache TTL when tokens >= prune; ChatCompaction/CompactionStrategy.wants() then says yes for a cold cache, the job announces compaction.started, and strategy.compact finds nothing to prune and returns none.
defects.repro: HATCH_PROVIDER_CACHE_TTL_MS=2000; a Chat conversation of about 190k estimated tokens made of plain text turns; after the last reply wait a few seconds and read hatch_conversation_journal for compaction.% events.
